variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally art-directed high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE HERO DESIGN still, wide 16:10 canvas, straight-on screen content only, no laptop or browser chrome, no perspective screen mockup. This is a visual direction proposal for the Korean education hub Codle (classroom platform, educational content, textbooks, AI camps, Jitda hackathons); not an existing product screenshot. Sophisticated playful brand graphic design with the clarity, confident geometric composition and precision of BUCK's Google Vids campaign, but ORIGINAL Codle design, no Google logos or Google colors copied wholesale. Existing Codle brand accent #3e88ff, near-black ink, ivory, thoughtful secondary colors. Same exact copy in all variants: logo text "codle" top-left in a small bold lowercase wordmark, nav "교육 프로그램" and "코들 입장", a compact nav button "도입 문의". Main headline in perfectly readable beautifully typeset modern Korean sans: "매일의 수업부터," on first line, "새로운 도전까지." on second line. Supporting line: "코들의 수업과 콘텐츠, 캠프부터 짓다 AI 해커톤까지." Primary button: "교육 프로그램 둘러보기" with small arrow. Secondary link "도입 문의". Footer edge small category navigation separated by generous space: "수업 플랫폼", "콘텐츠", "교과서", "AI 캠프", "짓다". Professional editorial spacing and hierarchy. No fake performance numbers, testimonials, stock people, dashboards, generic SaaS floating white cards, clay toys, confetti, glassmorphism, random gradients or device mockups. No 3-up collage: deliver a single finished screen. The artwork is abstract brand visualization, not factual product functionality. DIRECTION A — OPEN FRAME / refined spatial brand sculpture. Almost white ivory background. Header 8% height, quiet and precise. Headline on left (45% width) around vertical middle, huge but well spaced black lettering, second line blue. Right 55% is a striking large single assembly of flat editorial geometric planes: one broad cobalt rectangular portal with a soft rectangular cutout, an ivory folded paper plane intersecting the portal, a coral circular disc partly concealed by the fold, and one chartreuse rounded rectangular strip threaded through the center. Visually connected, not isolated floating objects. Restrained shallow 2.5D construction, thin paper/aluminum-like edges, crisp ambient shadows, mostly flat saturated surfaces, accurate believable occlusion. The opening reveals a small elegantly simplified creative canvas with a code-bracket mark, a black vector cursor, and modular geometric composition, not detailed UI. The assembly is art-directed like a premium brand launch still, occupies the full right half and cropped slightly at right edge. Huge clean negative space around left headline and CTA. A tiny "codle / 짓다" label belongs on a plane. Beautiful bold simplicity, two or three large shapes dominate, absolutely no small busy doodles.
